claims.statement: If you find sick or dead birds or animals, do not touch them, avoid contact, record what you see, and report them to the 24-hour Emergency Animal Disease Hotline on 1800 675 888.

As of the DAFF update of 5 July 2026, DAFF reported six confirmed H5 detections in wild birds (four WA, one SA, one NSW); DAFF states no evidence of mass mortality and no evidence of infection in poultry or the wider agriculture industry.
claims.publishNote: Always attributed to DAFF and dated; readers pointed to current DAFF advice.

claims.statement: The Australian Centre for Disease Control states the current risk to people in Australia is low.
Cleaning before disinfection is a core control principle; clean first, disinfect second, document third.
Restoration and IAQ members can assist with risk assessment, documentation, containment planning, cleaning records, disinfection records and client communication under authority direction.
CARSI/RestoreAssist/DisasterRecovery/NRPG support but do not replace government, veterinary, wildlife or public-health authorities.

Any disinfection method, including dry fogging (Halo/Halosil/NeoSan), is label-led, SDS-led and legally compliant, and is never a substitute for official biosecurity response or a product 'kill' claim.
The course teaches: reporting/awareness, WHS/PPE/hygiene, clean and dirty zones, clean-before-disinfect, field documentation, and professional boundaries (first module of a 7-module pathway).
claims.publishNote: Grounded in the live hub's stated pathway + the brief's course bundle. The course DETAIL page could not be independently read on 2026-07-08 (see carsi-h5-course).
